note: T258: the driving range's stand-ins the owner makes in ChatGPT (docs/art/CHATGPT-IMAGE-QUEUE.md 'First: the driving range's stand-ins'; GOLF-ART-LIST section 1). slug: the file name's stem under art/theme-consistency/generated/buildings/ (<slug>-view1-vN.png and <slug>-view2-vN.png for code A, <slug>-1view-vN.png for B); box: the footprint in metres (front width, depth); high: metres; size: 'box' sizes the picture by its footprint (its width spans the footprint's diamond, as T232's site kit), 'tall' by its height (64 px a metre, the uprights' scale, as T231's kit); piece: the range scene's piece key (rangebiz.ts rangeScene) the picture replaces (a prefix: every key starting with it).
